Doesn\'t look like music — opening YouTube
When off, links go straight to YouTube. Sharing a link to \"Open in Spotify\" still works.
Only videos that turn out to be music go to Spotify; everything else is passed to YouTube.
How long the \"Open in YouTube\" button stays up before Spotify opens.

1. If the YouTube / YouTube Music apps are installed, turn OFF "Open supported links" in their App info → Open by default.
2. Tap the button below → "Add link" and tick all youtube.com / youtu.be domains.

In Chrome this catches YouTube links you tap on other sites, in search results and in other apps. It can't catch clicks inside youtube.com itself or links typed into the address bar; for those use Chrome's Share → "Open in Spotify".
Android 11 or older: choose this app when Android asks how to open a YouTube link.
⚠️ \"Open supported links\" is off for this app.
Without credentials, songs Odesli can\'t match open as a Spotify search. With a free app from developer.spotify.com (Client ID + Secret) they open the best match directly.
